import {
  Group,
  Mesh,
  PlaneGeometry,
  MeshStandardNodeMaterial,
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial,
  DirectionalLight,
  PointLight,
  AmbientLight,
  Color,
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, fract, sin, dot, vec2, float } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

  const root = new Group();
  root.name = 'editorial-oversized-type';

  const colors =
    config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
      background: '#0b0b10',
      surface: '#14141a',
      ink: '#16161d',
      paper: '#e8ecf2',
      accent: '#ff2a38',

  const disposables = [];
  const timelines = [];

  const plateGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 5.5);
  const plateMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({ roughness: 0.62, metalness: 0.2 });
  {
    const bg = new Color(colors.background ?? '#0b0b10');
    const surf = new Color(colors.surface ?? '#14141a');
    const g = uv().y; // 0 bottom -> 1 top; gradient stop 0 = background at bottom
    const grad = mix(vec3(bg.r, bg.g, bg.b), vec3(surf.r, surf.g, surf.b), g);
    // 1.5% monochrome grain (engineered, static hash noise)
    const n = fract(sin(dot(uv().mul(vec2(912.7, 771.3)), vec2(12.9898, 78.233))).mul(43758.5453));
    plateMat.colorNode = grad.add(n.sub(0.5).mul(float(0.03)));

  const plate = new Mesh(plateGeo, plateMat);
  plate.position.set(0, 0, -0.06);
  root.add(plate);

  fill.position.set(-2.4, 0.6, 1.8);

  rim.position.set(-1.8, 2.8, -2);

  const bodyItem = byRole('body')[0];
  if (bodyItem) {
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(String(bodyItem.text), {
      fontSize: bodyItem.typography?.fontSize ?? 26,
      color: colors.paper ?? '#e8ecf2',
      align: 'left',
      maxWidthPx: 660, // ~4.5 scene units max width
    });
    addBlock(t, -0.8);

  const captionItem = byRole('caption')[0];
  if (captionItem) {

      fontSize: captionItem.typography?.fontSize ?? 18,
      color: colors.paper ?? '#e8ecf2',
      align: 'left',
      letterSpacingPx: 1.4, // 0.08em
    });
    addBlock(t, -1.9);
  }

  // ---- entranceMotion: rise-in stagger top-to-bottom, then rule draw ----
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  blocks.forEach((g, i) => {
    const targetY = g.position.y;
    g.position.y = targetY + 0.4;
    g.visible = false;
    tl.to(
      g.position,
      { y: targetY, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out' },
      i * 0.08
    ).set(g, { visible: true }, i * 0.08);
    // fade via per-mesh material opacity where available
    g.traverse((o) => {
      if (o.material && 'opacity' in o.material) {
        o.material.transparent = true;
        const target = o.material.opacity ?? 1;
        o.material.opacity = 0;
        tl.to(o.material, { opacity: target, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power2.out' }, i * 0.08);

    });

  tl.to(ruleGroup.scale, { x: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0.9);
  timelines.push(tl);

  root.userData.handlers = {};
  root.userData.cleanup = () => {
    timelines.forEach((t) => t.kill());
    disposables.forEach((d) => d.dispose && d.dispose());
    root.traverse((o) => {
      if (o.geometry && !disposables.includes(o.geometry)) o.geometry.dispose?.();
      if (o.material && !disposables.includes(o.material)) {
        o.material.map?.dispose?.();
        o.material.dispose?.();
      }
    });
  };

  return root;
}
